A '''Sith trooper''' was a member of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith trooper]] [[Army/Legends|army]] in [[138 ABY]]. Highly [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] was physically augmented and improved by Krayt for [[Time/Legends|decades]] beneath the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and forged into an unquestionably loyal servant. In 138 ABY, Krayt ordered the trooper to commit suicide as a demonstration of the army's loyalty to [[Darth Talon|two]] [[Darth Nihl|of]] his [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]]. The trooper ignited a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Death/Legends|died]] after being [[Shiak|impaled]] beneath the chin.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I began this project ''decades'' ago, culling those strongest in the Force shortly after their births&hellip; augmenting and improving them&hellip; forging them into my ''Sith troopers''.|Darth Krayt, speaking of his Sith trooper army|<ref name="Legacy 50" />}}
[[File:Obedienceunquestioning.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Krayt and his Sith Lords walk away from the trooper's corpse.]]
[[Time/Legends|Decades]] before [[138 ABY]],<ref name="Extremes Trade" /> a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual was discovered by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]] shortly after being [[Reproduction/Legends|born]]. Krayt gathered the individual and a number of other [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive [[Youngling/Legends|infants]] and began to physically augment and improve them, forging them into extremely loyal and obedient [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith troopers]]<ref name="Legacy 50" /> deep beneath the surface<ref name="Legacy 49">[[Legacy (2006) 49|''Legacy'' (2006) 49]]</ref> of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. He kept the project secret from his [[One Sith]] Order, whose members he knew to harbor their own ambitions and desires.<ref name="Legacy 50" />

By 138 ABY,<ref name="Extremes Trade" /> the individual had become a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] in the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] [[Army/Legends|army]]. The trooper was in Korriban's catacombs, guarding the doors to a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] full of [[Annihilator-class starfighter|''Annihilator''-class starfighters]], as Krayt gave a tour of the project's facilities to [[Darth Nihl]] and [[Darth Talon]], two of his most trusted [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]]. When Krayt ordered the trooper to commit suicide in a demonstration of the army's loyalty, the trooper immediately ignited a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and was [[Shiak|impaled]] beneath the chin before falling over, [[Death/Legends|dead]].<ref name="Legacy 50" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Their loyalty is unquestionable. [&hellip;] Their obedience unquestioning.|Darth Krayt, while using the trooper's suicide as an example of his army's loyalty|<ref name="Legacy 50" />}}
The Sith trooper was highly sensitive to the Force and was physically augmented and improved by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt for decades. Possessed of unquestionable loyalty and unquestioning obedience, the trooper followed Krayt's order to commit suicide without hesitation.<ref name="Legacy 50" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith trooper appeared on a single page of the [[Legacy (2006) 50|fifthieth and final issue]] of the [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', which was written by [[John Ostrander]], penciled by [[Jan Duursema]],<ref name="Legacy 50" /> and released on [[August 18]], [[2010]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54422/star_wars_legacy_2006_50|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #50}}</ref>
